Before submitting your remix, check that you've followed all the rules, and make adjustments if necessary:
Only @RDash75, @Twin138956Scratch, @Kyle3912Again, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @SmashBrosFan2020, @ScratchTeen9300, @ZYellow, @legofan208, @chomperthegamer, @BarryFans and anyone who remixed are allowed to break these rules.

Rules marked with ⚠️ can only be broken by @RDash75, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop and @ZYellow.
Rules marked with ☢️ can NOT be broken by anyone.
Rules marked with ❓ are optional - breaking them is allowed (unless it's too severely), but following them is recommended.

❓ 1. Remember REMIX ETIQUETTE: Notify people in the comments before starting a remix so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, don't remix if someone's already commented that they're remixing.

☢️ 2. DO NOT BREAK THE SCRATCH COMMUNITY GUIDELINES, so nothing too scary, gory, vulgar, or otherwise inappropriate!

⚠️ 3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking-rules list without RDash75's permission.

⚠️ 4. Don't delete any of these rules or instructions or completely change the project's title.

5. Don't delete or destructively modify anything you didn't make, unless to fix glitches, errors, or rule-breaks or to remove unused scripts.

6. (PLEASE respect ZYellow's opinion on this) Please don't add any characters from FNF. Music tracks from that game are allowed though. If you want to add FNF music tracks, you have to set an audio exemption for that game track. (if you like that game, then ZYellow respects your opinion).

7. Please don't change the hitbox's shape or size, everyone needs to have the same-sized hitbox to give everyone the same chances.

❓ 8. Please don't make your characters overly large; that'd waste space that could be used for more characters. It's recommended you keep larger characters nearer to the top or to the back layer so they block less ground.

9. Please don't add an intro or outro on this project or else it will slow down this project!

10. I don't recommend adding any singular characters that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 character), unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them.

11. Don't add any characters that are static images, even if you animate them, background included or not (EG: A PNG or JPEG of a Minecraft mob or some other thing).

12. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the community guidelines or they don't loop. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to make sure you can't.

13. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so that it can't have too much lag from this project.

14. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it or completely change it altogether!

❓ 15. Anyone on the breaking-rules list can add new rules if needed. Remember to add them to both the thumbnail's RULE RECAP comment and the Instructions.

VOICE GUIDE:

KICK VOICE: Sometime plays when your character about to kick the ball. They should be grunting.

*DELIGHT: Plays when your character kicked into the goal! They should feel happy.

*DESPAIR: Plays when your character didn't kick into the goal. They should feel sad or grumpy.

ELIMINATED: Plays if your character has been eliminated after they didn't kick into the goal!

WIN: Plays when your character feels happy that they won the game!

(an * means that you can add more if you want.)

1 - SCRATCH FOOTSTEPS, the classic footsteps from the Scratch Sound Library.

2 - CARTOON FOOTSTEPS, more defined step sounds used by scratchers like Twin138956Scratch and ZYellow.

3 - QUIET FOOTSTEPS, more quiet footstep sounds, used in ZYellow's "Add Yourself in Boulder Attack".

4 - REALISTIC FOOTSTEPS, more realistic and gentle footstep sounds.

ANYTHING ELSE - NO FOOTSTEP NOISES

Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into the "Add music" block & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! If you're unsure, testing is recommended.

If the music track or jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Sonic Shuffle, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020, via the audio-exemption lists & boolean. Same goes for other types of music like "gets faster" tracks, lyrical music, Flash/HTML5 game music, Miitopia music, FNF music & non-looping music. 

Burgnew_On_A_Laptop recommends you please don't add any more than around 80 music tracks and jingles total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.
